paper.title: First-Order Logic
paper.venue: Springer-Verlag, Ergebnisse der Mathematik und ihrer Grenzgebiete 43
paper.section: Part I, Chapter II — Analytic Tableaux (signed formulas, alpha/beta rules)
paper.claim: The K axiom A -> (B -> A) is a tautology; its signed tableau starting from F (A -> (B -> A)) closes using only alpha rules (no branching).
